description: This file is a PHP script with embedded HTML that renders a landing page for an online bus booking website. It includes form handling, session management, database queries to fetch bus details based on user-selected source and destination, and presents the data in an HTML table.

methods.name: session_start
methods.description: Initializes a session to store user data across multiple pages.

methods.name: mysqli_connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the MySQL database server.

methods.name: mysqli_query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query against the database.

methods.name: mysqli_fetch_row
methods.description: Fetches a result row as a numeric array.
